name: websuddhi
description: Block ads, remove paywalls, strip trackers, and clean up any website

scripts.build:all: node scripts/build-themes.mjs && node scripts/build-blocklists.mjs && node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs
scripts.build:safari: node scripts/build-blocklists.mjs && node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs && xcodebuild -project 'safari/WebSuddhi/WebSuddhi.xcodeproj' -scheme 'WebSuddhi (macOS)' -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:targets && playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build:targets && E2E_LIVE=1 playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs live.spec.mjs

author: Srinivas Pendela
